reason: Both descriptions identify the identical defect in isPublished(): the function no longer guards against a missing/undefined article (from articles.get() on an unresolved slug) before accessing article.draft, causing a TypeError that crashes the site build instead of the link being treated as unpublished/left alone. The reviewer adds concrete detail (regex capture group, example slugs) but the root cause (missing null-check on the map lookup result) and the failure mode (TypeError on .draft access crashing the build) are the same.
